propositions: Python public-API surface drifts due to manual upkeep burden on docs/reuse-surface.md (touched in ~20+ commits) and incomplete hardcoded drift guard in test_reuse_surface_doc.py

A portable, test-linked surface drift gate (analogous to config-key gate) must introspect rebar's pinned public modules, snapshot the baseline to committed JSON, and fail on removed/renamed/signature-changed symbols

The gate is implemented as scripts/gen_api_surface.py (--check/--update) and tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py (14 portable unit tests) using pure-stdlib inspect/importlib with no new dependency and no CI-provider dependency
The deleted test_reuse_surface_doc.py hardcoded-subset assertions must be subsumed by the new gate with full coverage proof (test_subsumes_* tests)

The gate captures per-symbol: callable parameter list (name+kind+default-repr), class bases+dataclass fields+public-method signatures, and pinned immutable constant values (e.g., prompts.FRONT_MATTER_KEYS)
